_comment: Reviewed exceptions to the container image scan (CI job `images`, Trivy), read by
scripts/image_scan.py. A HIGH or CRITICAL finding with a published fix fails the job
unless an entry here names it. Each entry: id (the CVE or GHSA id), image (backend |
frontend), package, reason (why it cannot be fixed now and why it does not reach this
service), review_by (YYYY-MM-DD). An entry past review_by fails, and so does one whose
finding is no longer reported (strike it off).
2026-09-26: empty. Trivy 0.74.0 over both images: no HIGH or CRITICAL finding with a fix.
The one fixable pair found (msgpack 1.1.2 GHSA-6v7p-g79w-8964 and setuptools 70.3.0
CVE-2025-47273: the copies pip 26.2.1 vendors, declared in its bundled bom.cdx.json) went
by removing pip, which nothing runs at run time, from the backend's runtime image.
The backend image's 44 HIGH findings in Debian 13 packages (util-linux, ncurses, systemd,
acl, perl-base) have no fixed version published; image_scan.py lists them without
failing, and a base-image bump picks the fixes up when Debian ships them.
